question.title: YoWallet Survey
question.description: Tell us how you find work and get paid. Your answers help shape YoWallet.

elements.name: custom:welcomeIntroText
elements.html:
Welcome

YoWallet is a new phone app. It helps young people find work, get paid and keep their money safe.

The YoWallet team wants to learn how you find work and get paid. This survey takes about 8 minutes. It is not a job application.

There are no right or wrong answers. You do not need to use AI or a money app. You can skip a question or stop at any time.

Only the YoWallet team sees your answers. We will never ask for your PIN, password or money.

A star * means you must answer.

elements.name: custom:helperIntroText
elements.html:
Imagine a free job helper in an app.

It can never accept a job, agree a price or touch your money.

You tell it your skills, when you are free and where you live. It finds jobs and writes applications for you. It can make mistakes. You can see everything it does and stop it at any time.

You can give it rules, like 'only jobs near me' or 'only weekend work'.
